name: Katei Kyoushi wa Majo Sensei! ~Kojin Jugyou wa H Juushi de~
original_name: 家庭教師は魔女先生！～個人授業はH重視で～
source:
Conglomerate's chief officer behaves outrageously selfishly. Leader sends two tutors to get him back on track. But the problem is that officer can't study unless he's involved into something naughty. Tutors have no way out, but to provide lessons alongside sex services. However, they have a great secret...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
财阀的一名高管任性妄为，首领便派出两名家庭教师，试图让他重回正轨。问题在于，如果不做些下流之事，他便根本学不进去。两名教师走投无路，只得一边授课，一边提供性服务。然而，她们还藏着一个重大秘密……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vndb-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
